A joint statement by the Iranian and Omani foreign ministries described a framework for the temporary corridor, though hurdles over navigation, jurisdiction and costs persist. Global oil prices dipped after the announcement. Trump has publicly disputed any blockade, calling the strait 'functioning' and claiming the US Navy fully cleared Iranian mines, but US allies privately warn the strait may still be mined; Trump says he is in no hurry for Iran to resume talks.
